scope: Pure numeric admission owned work and dependency composition; no native memory/work guarantee or universal UMF domain restriction

workRules.textVisit: Charge each visited source/token/diagnostic byte on every pass; cached identity cannot waive performed work
workRules.integerArithmetic: Before each bigint operation reserve the conservative selected producer bound from operand/result bit lengths; one operation is not automatically one work unit
workRules.dependencyCalls: Admit and reserve actual pinned UMF/parser/hash/copy/encoder worst-case work and peak before invocation; absent qualified bound refuses the affected call
workRules.scaling: Check precision/scale and predicted result bit/token size before pow10/multiplication or output allocation; no float-based bound approximation
workRules.peak: Include original input, decoded source, copied UMF values, intermediate/result/token/diagnostic buffers while they coexist; serialized output length alone is insufficient

failure: resource refusal; no candidate value, truncation, facet deletion, domain narrowing or native/host I/O
qualificationRequired: Pinned implementation/dependency producer bounds and actual allocation accounting
Independent exact/one-over limits across simultaneous buffers and repeated passes
Public Bun and Chromium equivalence with original UMF diagnostics
Complete packaged resource definition and exact digest/profile admission
